getting-started-talking-to-lokar-searunn.speaker: Lokar Searunner
getting-started-talking-to-lokar-searunn.text: Don't talk to me outerlander! I don't have time for the likes of you!

getting-started-talking-to-lokar-searunn.player: Hey! Don't call me outerlander! I'm known as the mighty [Fremennik name]!

getting-started-talking-to-lokar-searunn.speaker: Lokar Searunner
getting-started-talking-to-lokar-searunn.text: Can't say I've heard of you. So they let your sort into the clan nowadays? Wow. Things have really changed since I've been gone...

options.text: You don't look like a Fremennik yourself...

steps.player: You don't look like a Fremennik yourself...

steps.speaker: Lokar Searunner
steps.text: Yes, I suppose that's true... I have been gone such a long time...

options.text: You've been away from these parts a while?

steps.player: You've been away from these parts a while?

steps.speaker: Lokar Searunner
steps.text: Oh, you haven't heard of the infamous Lokar, scourge of the northern seas?

steps.player: Erm... no... That's you then, is it?

steps.speaker: Lokar Searunner
steps.text: Forgotten already? Tch! I have no regrets about why I left!

steps.player: Why did you leave?

steps.speaker: Lokar Searunner
steps.text: As a young man, I learnt that the Fremennik way of life was too slow for me...

steps.speaker: Lokar Searunner
steps.text: Oh, sure, every so often we got to go on big raiding parties, looting and pillaging the weaker islands around here for food and profit, but...

steps.speaker: Lokar Searunner
steps.text: Well, after a while, that was all I looked forward to doing.

steps.speaker: Lokar Searunner
steps.text: Growing crops, milking cows, catching and cooking food, the day to day activities of our life...

steps.speaker: Lokar Searunner
steps.text: THEY'RE SO BORING!

steps.speaker: Lokar Searunner
steps.text: No, I knew what I wanted to do, and that was attack innocent people going about their daily business, steal all their money, then spend it on wine, women and song!

steps.player: Oh.... Kaaaaay....

steps.speaker: Lokar Searunner
steps.text: So I ran away from Rellekka to become a PIRATE! It's way more fun. Plus you get to see the world!

steps.player: Was the world good then? Only, you seem to have returned to Rellekka after all.

steps.speaker: Lokar Searunner
steps.text: Yes, I have returned here, but that's only because we're short on supplies.

steps.player: I see. So where are you and your scurvy sea-dogs headed to next? Arrr shiver-me timbers!

steps.speaker: Lokar Searunner
steps.text: You're trying my patience...

steps.player: Sorry, got caught up in the moment.

steps.speaker: Lokar Searunner
steps.text: Indeed. Well, the rest of the group are at Lunar Isle at the moment. It's where the Moon Clan live.

steps.player: The Moon Clan... I think I've heard of them...

steps.speaker: Lokar Searunner
steps.text: I'd be surprised if you hadn't, they're the Fremenniks' most hated enemy!

steps.speaker: Lokar Searunner
steps.text: They've been at war with them for hundreds of years!

steps.speaker: Lokar Searunner
steps.text: Hmmm. Actually, that might be a problem for you then.

steps.player: A problem?

steps.speaker: Lokar Searunner
steps.text: Yeah, they're a really powerful race of mages. They'd read your mind and see that you're a Fremennik straight away, then probably turn you inside out and feed you to the birds.

steps.player: Cosmic.
But you went there okay?

steps.speaker: Lokar Searunner
steps.text: Yeah, but I think the Fremenniks are a bunch of losers. They probably picked up on that.

steps.speaker: Lokar Searunner
steps.text: Look, I know a way you'll be able to travel there without, you know, getting killed and that, if you fancy a trip!

steps.player: Why not, I've always wondered what the state of my innards are!

steps.speaker: Lokar Searunner
steps.text: That's the spirit!

steps.speaker: Lokar Searunner
steps.text: Well, what you want to do is go and talk to Brundt the Chieftain and get a Seal of Passage from him.

steps.player: A Seal of Passage? What's that?

steps.speaker: Lokar Searunner
steps.text: Well, it shows that you're a diplomat for the Fremennik, so you'll have immunity from being killed and stuff.

steps.speaker: Lokar Searunner
steps.text: It's an ancient tradition not to attack anyone bearing a Seal of Passage, because they're probably on a diplomatic mission. Or well connected with powerful allies. Either way, killing them is usually a bad idea.

steps.player: So I have to try and bring peace to two warring nations who have been fighting for centuries?!?!

steps.speaker: Lokar Searunner
steps.text: What? I never said you had to bother trying to do that, you just have to pretend like you might.

steps.speaker: Lokar Searunner
steps.text: No skin off my nose if those losers want to get slaughtered by the Moon Clan, just more stuff for me to loot when they're all dead.

steps.player: Well I will try. I am the mighty [Fremennik name] after all!

steps.speaker: Lokar Searunner
steps.text: Yes....

steps.player: So I just have to go talk to Brundt the Chieftain and tell him I want a Seal of Passage?
That's it? Because in my experience simple tasks like that always seem to take longer than I expect...

steps.speaker: Lokar Searunner
steps.text: Yeah, just go over and talk to the chief loser. You might have to tell him some rubbish he wants to hear, but that's it.

steps.speaker: Lokar Searunner
steps.text: Come back here when you got it, my supplies are loaded and I'm good to head back to our ship.

steps.player: Okay, I'll be right back.
No thanks, I'd like to live.

steps.speaker: Lokar Searunner
steps.text: Oh, so you're a loser like the rest of the Fremenniks then? See ya around, loser.

steps.player: Well, 'bye then.
Well, 'bye then.

getting-started-talking-to-lokar-searunn.speaker: Lokar Searunner
getting-started-talking-to-lokar-searunn.text: Hey there [Fremennik name]. So you get that seal thingy off of the Brundt the Chieftain yet?

getting-started-talking-to-lokar-searunn.speaker: Lokar Searunner
getting-started-talking-to-lokar-searunn.text: Well hurry it up, okay? I'm sick of this dump of a town, I want to go back to the ship!

options.text: Ask about a Seal of Passage.

steps.player: Hi there Brundt the Chieftain. Could you help me out with a Seal of Passage?

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: A Seal of Passage? Whatever for?

steps.player: Well, I've heard that there have been great troubles between your people and that of the Moon Clan. I was hoping to help. And so I need the Seal of Passage to show my intentions.

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: Ah [Fremennik name], many have tried, but The Moon Clan are by no means a sharing group of people. They do everything by magic, something we never use. But they are so secretive about it. If only they would share, we

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: wouldn't have to kill them all the time!

steps.player: I will see what I can do.
Can I have that seal then?

steps.text: If the player has no inventory space:

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: Yes, but you have no room to carry it. You should have thought of that before, [Fremennik name]!

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: If you are to bring peace to our two warring clans, then perhaps it is best that you do...
a seal of passage

options.text: Ask about a Seal of Passage.

steps.player: Hi there.

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: Yes?

steps.player: I lost my Seal of Passage!

steps.text: If the player has no inventory space:

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: So you want another one?

steps.player: Well... I would if I had space to carry one.

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: Oh dear...

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: Then you had better take a replacement and be less careless in future.

options.text: Ask about a Seal of Passage.

steps.player: Hi there.

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: Yes?

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: Ah, [Fremennik name]. How goes the peace talks with the accursed Moon Clan?

steps.player: Oh, you know. Ongoing negotiations.

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: I see. Well, I don't hold out for much hope!

steps.player: I'm glad you're confident in my abilities.

getting-started-returning-to-lokar-searu.speaker: Lokar Searunner
getting-started-returning-to-lokar-searu.text: So you got that seal yet from Brundt the Chieftain? Can I leave this dump of a town?

getting-started-returning-to-lokar-searu.player: Uh... yeah... Well, Brundt the Chieftain gave me a seal, but I think I lost it somewhere along the way...

getting-started-returning-to-lokar-searu.speaker: Lokar Searunner
getting-started-returning-to-lokar-searu.text: What are you? Useless? Go get another one from Brundt the Chieftain, and hurry it up, I don't want to be here any longer than I have to be!

getting-started-returning-to-lokar-searu.speaker: Lokar Searunner
getting-started-returning-to-lokar-searu.text: So you got that seal yet from Brundt the Chieftain? Can I leave this dump of a town?

getting-started-returning-to-lokar-searu.player: Yup, I've got it right here!

getting-started-returning-to-lokar-searu.speaker: Lokar Searunner
getting-started-returning-to-lokar-searu.text: Great! Then let's head back to my ship! You ready to go now?

options.text: Arrr! Yar! Let's be on our way, yar!

steps.player: Arrr! Yar! Let's be on our way, yar!

steps.speaker: Lokar Searunner
steps.text: ...Why are you talking like that?

steps.player: Um... isn't that how pirates talk?

steps.speaker: Lokar Searunner
steps.text: Only the very stupid ones...

steps.speaker: Lokar Searunner
steps.text: I suggest you DON'T talk like that to my crew. They will probably assume you are mocking them and kill you.

steps.speaker: Lokar Searunner
steps.text: So let's start again: Are you ready to go?

steps.player: Why yes! Tally-ho!

steps.speaker: Lokar Searunner
steps.text: I suppose that will have to do.

steps.speaker: Lokar Searunner
steps.text: Here we are at the Pirates' Cove! You'll find the captain already on board.

steps.player: Not just yet...

steps.speaker: Lokar Searunner
steps.text: Well hurry it up okay? This place is a dump, and I'm a vicious blood-thirsty pirate, not your personal travel agent.

pirates-cove-talking-to-lokar-searunner-.speaker: Lokar Searunner
pirates-cove-talking-to-lokar-searunner-.text: Hi again [Fremennik name]! What can I do for you?
If the player doesn't have the seal of passage:

steps.player: Do I still need the Seal of Passage?

steps.speaker: Lokar Searunner
steps.text: Yeah, why?

steps.player: I lost it.

steps.speaker: Lokar Searunner
steps.text: Silly you. You'll have to go back to Brundt the Chieftain to get another before you can go on to Lunar Isle.

options.text: Can you take me back to Rellekka?

steps.player: Can you take me back to Rellekka please?

steps.speaker: Lokar Searunner
steps.text: Hey, if you want to go back to loserville with all the losers, who am I to stop you?

steps.player: Nothing thanks! I just saw you here and thought I'd say hello!

steps.speaker: Lokar Searunner
steps.text: Hey, I knew you seemed cool when I met you [Fremennik name]!

pirates-cove-talking-to-lokar-searunner-.speaker: Lokar Searunner
pirates-cove-talking-to-lokar-searunner-.text: You won't make many friends on Lunar Isle without your Seal of Passage.

options.text: That's fine, I'm just going to Pirates' Cove.

steps.player: That's fine, I'm just going to Pirates' Cove.

options.text: Oh, I'd better go back and get it.

steps.player: Oh, I'd better go back and get it.

pirates-cove-talking-to-lokar-searunner-.player: Lokar, can you take me back to your ship?

pirates-cove-talking-to-lokar-searunner-.speaker: Lokar Searunner
pirates-cove-talking-to-lokar-searunner-.text: Sheesh, make your mind pal, I'm not a taxi service!

steps.player: Actually, I've changed my mind. Again. I don't want to go.

steps.speaker: Lokar Searunner
steps.text: You are possibly the most indecisive person I have ever met...

steps.player: Well, 'bye then.

pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.speaker: Cabin boy
pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.text: Hey, how you doing? You a stowaway?

pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.player: (sigh) NO, I am NOT a stowaway...
And to be honest, I don't know why everybody seems to think I am...

pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.speaker: Cabin boy
pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.text: Hey, I'm not here to judge you, if you're a stowaway you picked a good ship for it!

pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.speaker: Cabin boy
pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.text: There's lots of convenient hiding places around here - I should know, whenever I'm in trouble with the Captain I find myself a good barrel to hide in, until the fuss dies down.

pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.player: What exactly is it that a 'cabin boy' actually does on a pirate ship anyway?

pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.speaker: Cabin boy
pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.text: Mostly make coffee. Occasionally I have to swab the decks, but pirates aren't exactly known for cleanliness, you know?

pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.player: Hello. See anything good through your telescope there?

pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.speaker: 'Eagle-eye' Shultz
pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.text: Not really, just those creatures on the island. Don't worry, we sent some men out there to deal with them.

pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.speaker: 'Eagle-eye' Shultz
pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.text: The captain said we might have a barbecue out there later...

pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.player: You seem unhappy about that... Wouldn't a barbecue on the beach be fun?

pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.speaker: 'Eagle-eye' Shultz
pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.text: You obviously haven't met the cook yet...

pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.speaker: First mate 'Davey-boy'
pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.text: It is customary when stowing away on a vessel to not introduce yourself to the Captains First Mate, oh foolish one.

pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.player: That Lokar guy invited me aboard...

pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.speaker: First mate 'Davey-boy'
pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.text: I see. Well, don't distract me as I'm making preparations for departure.

pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.speaker: First mate 'Davey-boy'
pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.text: Try not to distract any of the crew either, Zamorak knows it's hard enough to get them to do any work around here without strangers wandering round the ship asking them inane questions.

pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.speaker: 'Birds-Eye' Jack
pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.text: Hi.

pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.speaker: 'Birds-Eye' Jack
pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.text: Me? I'm the navigator. My job is to ensure the ship travels where it's supposed to go once it's moving by constantly checking our

pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.speaker: 'Birds-Eye' Jack
pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.text: bearings against our plotted course, using charts and a sextant.

pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.speaker: 'Birds-Eye' Jack
pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.text: People often think that we just sail off when we feel like it, but its actually far more complicated than that!

pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.speaker: 'Birds-Eye' Jack
pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.text: Why, when you think of just how much sea there is out there, ANYTHING could happen if there wasn't a competent navigator on board ensuring that we reach our destination safely and in the shortest possible time!

pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.player: Okay. So... What are you doing?

pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.speaker: 'Birds-Eye' Jack
pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.text: As I say, being a navigator is a real skill - you really have to think on your feet!

pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.speaker: 'Birds-Eye' Jack
pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.text: Yesiree, once we get sailing, it's all up to me to make sure we don't run into trouble or go off course!

pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.speaker: 'Birds-Eye' Jack
pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.text: Yep, as the rest of the crew basically stand around not doing much, I'll be the one in the cabin, comparing wind speeds, landmarks and charts with my sextant, making sure that we get to the destination on time, and on

pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.speaker: 'Birds-Eye' Jack
pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.text: course!

pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.speaker: 'Birds-Eye' Jack
pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.text: You could almost say that I'm the linchpin of the entire operation! Why, if it wasn't for me, the rest of the guys might be sailing for, oooh, hours, and be slightly off course and

pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.speaker: 'Birds-Eye' Jack
pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.text: never even known it!

pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.speaker: 'Birds-Eye' Jack
pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.text: They might even be a few hours late for their destination! Or a few miles down the road from it!

pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.speaker: 'Birds-Eye' Jack
pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.text: And then where would they be?

pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.player: A few hours late or a few miles down the road?

pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.speaker: 'Birds-Eye' Jack
pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.text: Exactly!

pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.player: Great. So... What are you doing?

pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.speaker: 'Birds-Eye' Jack
pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.text: Oh, just relaxing while I wait for the ship to cast off.

pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.speaker: 'Birds-Eye' Jack
pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.text: When we're sailing I'll be very busy you know! I'm probably the single most important person on board when we're sailing!

pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.speaker: 'Beefy' Burns
pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.text: The galley ain't open fer food yet whipper-snapper, ye'll hafta come back later if'n ye be wanting food.

pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.player: Uh... something something open, something something food?

pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.speaker: 'Beefy' Burns
pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-before-.text: Aye, ter be sure, yer yella-bellied land-lizard!

pirates-cove-talking-to-captain-bentley-.speaker: Captain Bentley
pirates-cove-talking-to-captain-bentley-.text: Hmmmm? I don't recognise you as one of my men, what are you doing aboard my ship?

pirates-cove-talking-to-captain-bentley-.speaker: Parrot
pirates-cove-talking-to-captain-bentley-.text: Stowaway! Stowaway! *Squark*

pirates-cove-talking-to-captain-bentley-.player: Oh, Lokar offered me a journey. He said you could take me to the island of the Moon Clan.

pirates-cove-talking-to-captain-bentley-.speaker: Captain Bentley
pirates-cove-talking-to-captain-bentley-.text: Oh he DID, did he? (sigh) I sometimes regret ever allowing that vagabond to join the crew.

pirates-cove-talking-to-captain-bentley-.speaker: Captain Bentley
pirates-cove-talking-to-captain-bentley-.text: He has a very bad work ethic, and I have to say his attitude can be very confrontational.

pirates-cove-talking-to-captain-bentley-.speaker: Parrot
pirates-cove-talking-to-captain-bentley-.text: Lokar's a loser! *Brakawk*!

pirates-cove-talking-to-captain-bentley-.player: So... You won't take me to Lunar Isle?

pirates-cove-talking-to-captain-bentley-.speaker: Captain Bentley
pirates-cove-talking-to-captain-bentley-.text: Well now, I didn't say that.

pirates-cove-talking-to-captain-bentley-.speaker: Captain Bentley
pirates-cove-talking-to-captain-bentley-.text: We are returning there again soon anyway, as our last visit was most profitable.

pirates-cove-talking-to-captain-bentley-.speaker: Captain Bentley
pirates-cove-talking-to-captain-bentley-.text: In fact as soon as our boys are finished loading stocks we should be ready to depart!

pirates-cove-talking-to-captain-bentley-.speaker: Captain Bentley
pirates-cove-talking-to-captain-bentley-.text: Now, as captain of this ship I feel I must play host, even if you aren't exactly a welcome guest, so was there anything you wished to know?

options.text: Can you tell me something about the Moon Clan?

steps.player: So... What can you tell me about this 'Moon Clan'? It all seems very mysterious I must say...

steps.speaker: Captain Bentley
steps.text: The Moon Clan? Oh, very fine people. Very hospitable.

steps.speaker: Captain Bentley
steps.text: We had heard that they are very wary of strangers, and dislike people just showing up on their island, but when we sent a landing party aboard they all seemed more than happy to see us.

steps.speaker: Captain Bentley
steps.text: Well, they even threw a big festival in our honour!

steps.speaker: Captain Bentley
steps.text: Anyway, they had a large supply of items that we felt we could use on the high seas, so we made a few trades with them, and were on our way.

steps.player: What kinds of items?

steps.speaker: Captain Bentley
steps.text: Well, I'm not sure how much you've heard about them, but they are magical experts.

steps.speaker: Captain Bentley
steps.text: They sold us many rune-stones, as well as a few good luck charms and talismans and such to help us on our voyage.

steps.speaker: Captain Bentley
steps.text: Yes, they might have been a little secretive about that strange temple, and the old lodge of theirs in town, and I must say they certainly have the strangest house I have ever seen in my life in their little village, but it was

steps.speaker: Captain Bentley
steps.text: a pleasant trip all round, and I look forward to trading there again in the future.

steps.speaker: Captain Bentley
steps.text: After all, it's not everywhere that a pirate captain and his crew can rest ashore without having to worry about the authorities catching them, is it?

steps.speaker: Parrot
steps.text: Fight the law! *Squawk*

steps.player: No, I guess it isn't.

steps.speaker: Captain Bentley
steps.text: Was there anything else you wished to ask me about while I'm not busy?

options.text: What were you doing at Lunar Isle?

steps.player: What were you doing at Lunar Isle anyway? I always thought pirates would be... You know. Out pirating.

steps.speaker: Captain Bentley
steps.text: Well, obviously the actual pirating is a big part of our agenda, but we like to think of ourselves as non- regulated merchants.

steps.speaker: Captain Bentley
steps.text: What good is plunder if you have nothing to spend it on, hmmmm?

steps.speaker: Captain Bentley
steps.text: Likewise, I am a forward thinking captain, and endeavour to invest much of my plunder back into the ship and its crew, so that we can be a better and more efficient force for theft upon the seas.

steps.player: So you went to Lunar Isle for supplies?

steps.speaker: Captain Bentley
steps.text: Well, obviously not initially. Obviously, our first thought was to show up, rob them blind, then take off again with the plunder spilling from our decks.

steps.player: So what made you change your mind?

steps.speaker: Captain Bentley
steps.text: Well, firstly there were the monsters.

steps.player: M-monsters?

steps.speaker: Captain Bentley
steps.text: Oh yes, hundreds of the things. The island's swarming with them you know.

steps.speaker: Captain Bentley
steps.text: Dirty smelly beasts, as big as a wolf! Yes, you'd certainly better be either handy with a blade or quick on your toes if you wanted to spend much time outside of their village with those things around

steps.speaker: Captain Bentley
steps.text: everywhere.

steps.speaker: Parrot
steps.text: Squawk* Run fer yer lives lads, it's a monster! *Squawk*

steps.player: So you didn't attack the Moon Clan because you were worried you would yourself be attacked by these monsters trying to make your escape?

steps.speaker: Captain Bentley
steps.text: Oh yes, absolutely. That and the next reason.

steps.player: The next reason?

steps.speaker: Captain Bentley
steps.text: Yes, the next reason being that the Moon Clan are quite stupendously powerful magicians.

steps.speaker: Captain Bentley
steps.text: You'll notice it as soon as you look at them, really quite, quite powerful indeed.

steps.speaker: Captain Bentley
steps.text: As soon as we saw them we lost any thoughts about trying to attack or steal from them.

steps.speaker: Captain Bentley

pirates-cove-talking-to-eagle-eye-shultz.player: Hello there. So, I'm wondering if you know anything about a jinx at all?

pirates-cove-talking-to-eagle-eye-shultz.speaker: 'Eagle-eye' Shultz
pirates-cove-talking-to-eagle-eye-shultz.text: A jinx you say? Argh, those are evil things!

pirates-cove-talking-to-eagle-eye-shultz.player: Quick question: What exactly is a jinx anyway?

pirates-cove-talking-to-eagle-eye-shultz.speaker: 'Eagle-eye' Shultz
pirates-cove-talking-to-eagle-eye-shultz.text: Ah, well they take many forms.

pirates-cove-talking-to-eagle-eye-shultz.speaker: 'Eagle-eye' Shultz
pirates-cove-talking-to-eagle-eye-shultz.text: Sometimes it will just be a person with such staggeringly bad luck that everything they do or say invariably leads them into trouble and commotion, through no fault of their own.

pirates-cove-talking-to-eagle-eye-shultz.speaker: 'Eagle-eye' Shultz
pirates-cove-talking-to-eagle-eye-shultz.text: Everything they touch will always bring them misery, and everything they think they have achieved will always end in disaster.

pirates-cove-talking-to-eagle-eye-shultz.speaker: 'Eagle-eye' Shultz
pirates-cove-talking-to-eagle-eye-shultz.text: But then there is the other kind of jinx, the even worse kind.

pirates-cove-talking-to-eagle-eye-shultz.speaker: 'Eagle-eye' Shultz
pirates-cove-talking-to-eagle-eye-shultz.text: It is a curse put upon someone, often attached to an object of some kind, and it is done deliberately, so that misfortune will always follow the owner of that object.

pirates-cove-talking-to-eagle-eye-shultz.player: So why is it such a big deal to sailors?

pirates-cove-talking-to-eagle-eye-shultz.speaker: 'Eagle-eye' Shultz
pirates-cove-talking-to-eagle-eye-shultz.text: Ah, well now. When you're on land, bad luck can be an annoyance, and possibly even bring you grief, but it is rarely deadly.

pirates-cove-talking-to-eagle-eye-shultz.speaker: 'Eagle-eye' Shultz
pirates-cove-talking-to-eagle-eye-shultz.text: A jinx on land may fall over tree roots, or lose their coins down a drain, or some other irritation.

pirates-cove-talking-to-eagle-eye-shultz.speaker: 'Eagle-eye' Shultz
pirates-cove-talking-to-eagle-eye-shultz.text: But at sea! With nothing saving you from the cold murky death of drowning except the wood below your feet?

pirates-cove-talking-to-eagle-eye-shultz.speaker: 'Eagle-eye' Shultz
pirates-cove-talking-to-eagle-eye-shultz.text: Why, jinxes can kill not just you, but the entire crew of a ship! They are an evil thing indeed, and the only thing you can do to save yourself and your crew is to forcibly

pirates-cove-talking-to-eagle-eye-shultz.speaker: 'Eagle-eye' Shultz
pirates-cove-talking-to-eagle-eye-shultz.text: remove the jinx from the ship as soon as possible. Dead or alive.

pirates-cove-talking-to-eagle-eye-shultz.speaker: 'Eagle-eye' Shultz
pirates-cove-talking-to-eagle-eye-shultz.text: Or casting some kind of anti-curse magic upon the jinxed item might work, but to be honest, throwing them overboard is quicker.

pirates-cove-talking-to-eagle-eye-shultz.player: Wait, so someone with magical powers can deliberately place a jinx upon someone or something?

pirates-cove-talking-to-eagle-eye-shultz.speaker: 'Eagle-eye' Shultz
pirates-cove-talking-to-eagle-eye-shultz.text: Oh, yes. But they would have to be a very magical and very evil person to risk the lives of an entire ship over some trivial matter.

pirates-cove-talking-to-eagle-eye-shultz.player: Someone highly magical like, oh, let's say for the sake of argument, the inhabitants of Lunar Isle, a.k.a the Moon Clan?

pirates-cove-talking-to-eagle-eye-shultz.speaker: 'Eagle-eye' Shultz
pirates-cove-talking-to-eagle-eye-shultz.text: Well, I suppose so... But for them to curse our entire boat?

pirates-cove-talking-to-eagle-eye-shultz.speaker: 'Eagle-eye' Shultz
pirates-cove-talking-to-eagle-eye-shultz.text: Somebody from the landing party must have done something highly offensive to them at the feast for them to place such an evil enchantment that risks the lives of the entire crew.

pirates-cove-talking-to-eagle-eye-shultz.player: So somebody from the landing party must have gotten themselves jinxed...

pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-while-i.player: ...What?

pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-while-i.text: ...Nothing. I didn't do anything. At all.

pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-while-i.text: And nobody can prove that I did, even if I had, which I didn't so they can't. So there.

pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-while-i.player: Okay, okay, I believe you, I believe you. There's no need to shout at me.

pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-while-i.speaker: Cabin boy

pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-while-i.text: Ah, just come out and say it. I'm a pirate, it's not like I get offended easily.

pirates-cove-talking-to-the-crew-while-i.speaker: 'Birds-Eye' Jack

obtaining-the-waking-sleep-potion-talkin.player: Hello.

obtaining-the-waking-sleep-potion-talkin.speaker: Oneiromancer
obtaining-the-waking-sleep-potion-talkin.text: Why hello, how are you today?

obtaining-the-waking-sleep-potion-talkin.speaker: Oneiromancer
obtaining-the-waking-sleep-potion-talkin.text: Fine. Yes I know.

obtaining-the-waking-sleep-potion-talkin.player: What? How'd you...

obtaining-the-waking-sleep-potion-talkin.speaker: Oneiromancer
obtaining-the-waking-sleep-potion-talkin.text: By reading your mind. But that's not important. We have some important things to discuss.

obtaining-the-waking-sleep-potion-talkin.player: We do? This is going to take some time getting used to.

obtaining-the-waking-sleep-potion-talkin.speaker: Oneiromancer
obtaining-the-waking-sleep-potion-talkin.text: Of course! I can see that you come bearing great promise.

obtaining-the-waking-sleep-potion-talkin.player: Great promise?

obtaining-the-waking-sleep-potion-talkin.speaker: Oneiromancer
obtaining-the-waking-sleep-potion-talkin.text: Please. Just tell me why you have come to our island.

obtaining-the-waking-sleep-potion-talkin.player: Well, I'm seeking some kind of settlement between your clan and the Fremenniks. I understand there has been a dispute for a great many years and being a member of the Fremennik clan I wanted to come as a
representative to see if something couldn't be sorted out.

obtaining-the-waking-sleep-potion-talkin.speaker: Oneiromancer
obtaining-the-waking-sleep-potion-talkin.text: A very honourable objective, but how do you suppose this will be possible?

obtaining-the-waking-sleep-potion-talkin.player: That's what I was hoping you may be able to help me out with.
Can you tell me more of why you don't feel your people get on with the Fremenniks?

obtaining-the-waking-sleep-potion-talkin.speaker: Oneiromancer
obtaining-the-waking-sleep-potion-talkin.text: We are very in tune with magic as you have no doubt observed, but we have yet to meet one Fremennik with the perspective that this is of any value. They are always picking at us to reveal our secrets, but why

obtaining-the-waking-sleep-potion-talkin.speaker: Oneiromancer
obtaining-the-waking-sleep-potion-talkin.text: should we when they view us so.

obtaining-the-waking-sleep-potion-talkin.player: I think you'd be surprised at how flexible they could be. I think they just feel like you put yourselves on a higher pedestal to look down at them. They don't like that and can't see what is so special about you and
your ways.

obtaining-the-waking-sleep-potion-talkin.speaker: Oneiromancer
obtaining-the-waking-sleep-potion-talkin.text: Hmmm. Well you are one of them. Perhaps if you can understand our ways, that will at least be a start. How does that sound to you?

obtaining-the-waking-sleep-potion-talkin.player: Fine. I am always eager to learn.
What sort of thing had you in mind?

obtaining-the-waking-sleep-potion-talkin.speaker: Oneiromancer
obtaining-the-waking-sleep-potion-talkin.text: Well, we have a ritual called 'The View of Self Dream'. It is a ritual that we all have to go through. You see the path to understanding magic is through understanding ourselves. It is a power innate to every

obtaining-the-waking-sleep-potion-talkin.speaker: Oneiromancer
obtaining-the-waking-sleep-potion-talkin.text: living creature, but it takes a great understanding of self to tap into. One of the best ways to understand ourselves is through our dreams. These are a demonstration of our subconscious, our subconscious

obtaining-the-waking-sleep-potion-talkin.speaker: Oneiromancer
obtaining-the-waking-sleep-potion-talkin.text: being raw and true. But it takes many years to get into a situation where you are ready to attempt it.

obtaining-the-waking-sleep-potion-talkin.player: I'm not so sure I want to wait years to solve this... Is there any way I can just attempt this ritual now?

obtaining-the-waking-sleep-potion-talkin.speaker: Oneiromancer
obtaining-the-waking-sleep-potion-talkin.text: I don't mind you trying, but I really doubt you'll achieve anything. There are also a fair few preparations you'll have to make first too.

obtaining-the-waking-sleep-potion-talkin.player: That's OK. What do I have to do?

obtaining-the-waking-sleep-potion-talkin.speaker: Oneiromancer
obtaining-the-waking-sleep-potion-talkin.text: You are going to need to do a few things. You'll need a waking sleep potion, a Lunar staff, and ceremonial traveling clothes. Start with the potion, I suggest you have a word with Baba Yaga in her chicken house,

obtaining-the-waking-sleep-potion-talkin.speaker: Oneiromancer
obtaining-the-waking-sleep-potion-talkin.text: she will be able to help you with the making of the potion.

obtaining-the-waking-sleep-potion-talkin.player: Chicken house?

obtaining-the-waking-sleep-potion-talkin.speaker: Oneiromancer
obtaining-the-waking-sleep-potion-talkin.text: Yes, you can't miss it, it's walking around the north of the town.

obtaining-the-waking-sleep-potion-talkin.player: Hi, what was I supposed to be doing again?

obtaining-the-waking-sleep-potion-talkin.speaker: Oneiromancer
obtaining-the-waking-sleep-potion-talkin.text: Seek Baba Yaga, she is in her chicken house to the north of our island. She should be able to help you out with the potion of waking sleep.

obtaining-the-waking-sleep-potion-talkin.player: Thanks.
Hi.
